rule: A published statement is true only if code makes it true, and code checks that on every change. A line on a public surface that states a number, a cadence, a guarantee or an automatic behaviour is bound to a probe (registered claim: exact quote + probe file + string the probe must contain) or sits in the shrink-only baseline that the executor drains. Tenant pages render statements from config with core/statements (probed at runtime and in CI).

skip_reasons.self-data\\.js: SELF-MODEL-1: a generated mirror of the loop registry, clocks and boundary declarations (the code's own statements about itself), kept equal to them by `foundation selfmodel --check`; it authors no statement of its own.
skip_reasons.research-data\\.js: RESEARCH-1: generated by foundation/research.py. Its numbers are either measurements computed from the ledgers by `measures()` (tests/foundation/test_research.py) or figures quoted from a study file in research/studies, and its mechanism lines name paths `research --check` proves exist; it authors no statement of its own.
skip_reasons.temporal-data\\.js: TEMPORAL-1: generated by foundation/temporal.py from the repository's own history and ledgers (series, findings, predictions it computed); it authors no statement of its own, and site/temporal.js renders it.
skip_reasons.yearfail-data\\.js: YEARFAIL-1: generated by foundation/yearfail.py from a real run on every weekly run; each cell is a measured result or the quoted evidence of a detector, and the page labels what was simulated; it authors no statement of its own (tests/foundation/test_yearfail.py).
skip_reasons.saydo-data\\.js: SAY-DO-1: generated by foundation/saydo.py from ops/saydo.json; its lines quote the gaps the say-do check measured (statement and probe output) and author no statement of their own; `saydo --check` fails when it is stale.
skip_reasons.yearsim-data\\.js: YEAR-SIM-1: generated by foundation/yearsim.py from ops/yearsim.json; every number is a simulation output and every evidence line is a drill result; `yearsim --check` fails when it is stale.
skip_reasons.trajectory-data\\.js: TRAJECTORY-1: generated by foundation/trajectory.py from ops/trajectory.json; every number is read from git and the ops ledgers and it authors no statement of its own; `trajectory --check` fails when stale.
skip_reasons.intent-yield-data\\.js: INTENT-YIELD-1: generated by foundation/intentyield.py. Its titles are the owner's own directive titles copied from agents/AGENTS.md (already scanned there) and its numbers are verdicts computed by running each directive's own probe; it authors no statement of its own.
